raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Adds vLLM's `--goodput` option to `bench_serving`: a run reports how many requests per second met their latency SLOs, and what share did.

## Motivation

`bench_serving` reports throughput and latency percentiles, but not how much of the load met a latency target; that has to be computed by hand from `--output-details`. Goodput, the load served within its SLOs, is the metric SLO-aware serving work optimises and reports (e.g. [JITServe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20068), NSDI '26), and vLLM's benchmark already has the option. #5495 proposed it for the old `bench_serving.py` and was closed as stale after a request to rebase.

## Modifications

- `--goodput KEY:VALUE ...` with keys `ttft`, `tpot`, `e2el` in milliseconds, e.g. `--goodput ttft:2000 tpot:100`. A request is good if it succeeded and met every listed SLO.
- The run prints, and writes to the result file, request goodput (good requests per second), SLO attainment (good / sent) and the attainment of each SLO alone. Without the flag the output is unchanged.
- The scoring is a new module, `python/sglang/benchmark/goodput.py`; `serving.py` gains 40 lines of wiring.
- A docs section and two unit cases.

```
---------------------Goodput----------------------
SLOs (ms):                               ttft:2000 tpot:100 e2el:20000
Request goodput (req/s):                 28.37
SLO attainment (%):                      63.48
TTFT SLO attainment (%):                 100.00
TPOT SLO attainment (%):                 86.72
E2EL SLO attainment (%):                 76.49
```

## Accuracy Tests

No model or server code is touched. For the metric: unit cases with hand-computed values, and on a live server (`Qwen/Qwen3-8B`, one H200) the printed values equal an independent recount of the per-request records in 8 runs over the `sglang-oai-chat` and `sglang` backends.

Not changed here: a streaming request that the server aborts inside a 200 response is still recorded as successful by the benchmark (#40881), so it can count as good.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No inference path is touched. An example of the output, a load sweep on this branch (ShareGPT, `--goodput ttft:2000 tpot:100 e2el:20000`, 50 s of arrivals per row):

| request rate (req/s) | output tok/s | goodput (req/s) | SLO attainment |
|---|---|---|---|
| 20.5 | 3684 | 18.89 | 100.0 % |
| 32.8 | 5516 | 28.74 | 99.8 % |
| 40.9 | 6488 | 33.20 | 99.6 % |
| 51.2 | 7480 | 35.55 | 93.0 % |
| 65.5 | 8785 | 28.37 | 63.5 % |
| 81.9 | 9688 | 9.23 | 18.8 % |

Output throughput keeps rising while goodput peaks near 50 req/s. One run per row; just past the peak a 50-second run is noisy (repeated runs near 65 req/s ranged from 37 to 72 %). The block above is the 65.5 req/s row.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -245,6 +245,25 @@ Printed after each run:
 
 The script also retokenizes generated text with the configured tokenizer and reports "retokenized" counts.
 
+### Goodput
+
+Throughput counts every completed request, including the ones that came back too late to be useful. Pass service level objectives with `--goodput` to count only the requests that met them:
+
+```bash Command
+python3 -m sglang.bench_serving \
+  --backend sglang --host 127.0.0.1 --port 30000 \
+  --num-prompts 1000 --request-rate 16 \
+  --goodput ttft:500 tpot:50 e2el:20000
+```
+
+Each entry is `KEY:VALUE` in milliseconds, with `KEY` one of `ttft`, `tpot`, `e2el` (end-to-end latency). A request is good if it succeeded and met every listed SLO; a single-token response has a TPOT of 0. The run then also prints:
+
+- Request goodput (req/s): good requests per second
+- SLO attainment (%): good requests over all requests sent, so failed requests count as misses
+- One attainment line per listed SLO, which shows which SLO is the binding one
+
+Sweeping `--request-rate` and reading goodput gives the highest rate the deployment sustains within its SLOs: throughput keeps rising or flattens under overload, goodput peaks and then falls.
+
 ### JSONL output format
 
 When `--output-file` is set, one JSON object is appended per run. Base fields:
@@ -253,6 +272,7 @@ When `--output-file` is set, one JSON object is appended per run. Base fields:
 - Duration and totals: completed, total_input_tokens, total_output_tokens, retokenized totals
 - Throughputs and latency statistics as printed in the console
 - `accept_length` when available (sglang)
+- `goodput_slos_ms`, `request_goodput`, `slo_attainment`, `slo_attainment_by_metric` when `--goodput` is given
 
 With `--output-details`, an extended object also includes arrays:

+"""Goodput for the serving benchmark: the requests that met every given latency SLO."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import msgspec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.benchmark.serving import RequestFuncOutput
+
+GOODPUT_SLO_METRICS = ("ttft", "tpot", "e2el")
+
+
+class GoodputMetrics(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
+    """Field names are the keys written to the benchmark result file."""
+
+    goodput_slos_ms: dict[str, float]
+    request_goodput: float  # good requests per second
+    slo_attainment: float  # good requests / requests sent
+    slo_attainment_by_metric: dict[str, float]
+
+
+def calculate_goodput(
+    outputs: list[RequestFuncOutput], goodput_slos: dict[str, float], dur_s: float
+) -> GoodputMetrics:
+    num_good = 0
+    num_met = dict.fromkeys(goodput_slos, 0)
+    for output in outputs:
+        if not output.success:
+            continue
+        # A single-token response has no inter-token interval; its TPOT counts as 0.
+        tpot = 0.0
+        if output.output_len > 1:
+            tpot = (output.latency - output.ttft) / (output.output_len - 1)
+        observed_ms = {
+            "ttft": output.ttft * 1000,
+            "tpot": tpot * 1000,
+            "e2el": output.latency * 1000,
+        }
+        met = [name for name, slo in goodput_slos.items() if observed_ms[name] <= slo]
+        for name in met:
+            num_met[name] += 1
+        if len(met) == len(goodput_slos):
+            num_good += 1
+    return GoodputMetrics(
+        goodput_slos_ms=goodput_slos,
+        request_goodput=num_good / dur_s,
+        slo_attainment=num_good / len(outputs),
+        slo_attainment_by_metric={
+            name: count / len(outputs) for name, count in num_met.items()
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def print_goodput(goodput: GoodputMetrics) -> None:
+    slos = " ".join(f"{name}:{slo:g}" for name, slo in goodput.goodput_slos_ms.items())
+    print("{s:{c}^{n}}".format(s="Goodput", n=50, c="-"))
+    print("{:<40} {:<10}".format("SLOs (ms):", slos))
+    print(
+        "{:<40} {:<10.2f}".format("Request goodput (req/s):", goodput.request_goodput)
+    )
+    print(
+        "{:<40} {:<10.2f}".format("SLO attainment (%):", goodput.slo_attainment * 100)
+    )
+    for name, attainment in goodput.slo_attainment_by_metric.items():
+        label = f"{name.upper()} SLO attainment (%):"
+        print("{:<40} {:<10.2f}".format(label, attainment * 100))

+"""Unit tests for the goodput bench_serving reports under --goodput."""
+
+import argparse
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.benchmark.goodput import calculate_goodput
+from sglang.benchmark.serving import RequestFuncOutput, _goodput_slo
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+DURATION_S = 10.0
+
+
+def _output(ttft, latency, output_len, success=True):
+    return RequestFuncOutput(
+        success=success, ttft=ttft, latency=latency, output_len=output_len
+    )
+
+
+# ttft / tpot / e2el in ms: 100 / 100 / 900, 500 / 100 / 900, 200 / 200 / 2200,
+# 200 / 0 / 200 (a single token), then one failed request.
+OUTPUTS = [
+    _output(ttft=0.1, latency=0.9, output_len=9),
+    _output(ttft=0.5, latency=0.9, output_len=5),
+    _output(ttft=0.2, latency=2.2, output_len=11),
+    _output(ttft=0.2, latency=0.2, output_len=1),
+    _output(ttft=0.0, latency=0.0, output_len=0, success=False),
+]
+
+
+class TestBenchServingGoodput(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_request_is_good_only_if_it_meets_every_listed_slo(self):
+        all_three = {"ttft": 3 / 5, "tpot": 3 / 5, "e2el": 3 / 5}
+        # (--goodput entries, good requests, attainment of each listed SLO alone)
+        cases = [
+            (["ttft:300", "tpot:150", "e2el:1000"], 2, all_three),
+            (["ttft:300"], 3, {"ttft": 3 / 5}),
+            # Dividing by output_len instead would give 88.9 and 80 ms, and pass.
+            (["tpot:95"], 1, {"tpot": 1 / 5}),
+        ]
+        for entries, num_good, by_metric in cases:
+            with self.subTest(entries=entries):
+                goodput = calculate_goodput(
+                    outputs=OUTPUTS,
+                    goodput_slos=dict(map(_goodput_slo, entries)),
+                    dur_s=DURATION_S,
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(goodput.request_goodput, num_good / DURATION_S)
+                self.assertEqual(goodput.slo_attainment, num_good / len(OUTPUTS))
+                self.assertEqual(goodput.slo_attainment_by_metric, by_metric)
+
+    def test_invalid_slo_entries_are_rejected(self):
+        for entry in ["itl:10", "ttft:0"]:
+            with self.subTest(entry=entry):
+                with self.assertRaises(argparse.ArgumentTypeError):
+                    _goodput_slo(entry)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
